_comment: REST services the generic `api` command can drive. Append only. A row of your own in ~/.config/openapi/services.json wins on a name clash. auth: bearer | header:NAME | basic (env holds user:password) | query:NAME. verified: the date the base URL and auth scheme were read in the vendor docs or a search result; empty = from memory, check before trusting. Needs request signing or OAuth (not supported here): OVHcloud, Contabo, Oracle Cloud, AWS.

services.name: hetzner
services.notes: Token is per project, Read or Read&Write. Servers, volumes, firewalls, networks, floating IPs, load balancers; every action is an API call.

services.name: hostinger
services.notes: Token from hPanel > API, inherits the creator's rights, can expire. Paths are /api/<product>/<version>/...

services.name: flyio
services.notes: Machines API: containers that boot in a second. No PATCH: fetch the config, change it, send it whole. OpenAPI spec at https://docs.machines.dev/openapi.json. One Fly page says `Authorization: FlyV1 <token>` for some token kinds.

services.name: digitalocean
services.notes: Droplets, volumes, domains, App Platform, spaces keys.

services.name: vultr
services.notes: The key can be limited to chosen IPs in the account settings: add this machine first.

services.name: scaleway
services.notes: Paths carry the product, zone and version, e.g. /instance/v1/zones/fr-par-1/servers.

services.name: upcloud
services.notes: Env holds user:password of an API-only sub-account.

services.name: cloudflare
services.notes: DNS, Workers, Pages, R2, tunnels, firewall. Scope the token to what it needs.

services.name: bunny
services.notes: CDN pull zones, storage zones, DNS.

services.name: render
services.notes: Services, deploys, env vars, cron jobs.

services.name: railway
services.notes: GraphQL: POST with {"query": "..."} to the base URL, use path /.

services.name: github
services.notes: Repos, Pages, Actions, releases. gh api does the same with its own login.

services.name: notion
services.notes: Pages must be shared with the integration.

services.name: coderabbit
services.notes: Admin and metrics API, not an LLM.
